# Examples group list filters across all groups and fields as the visitor types

## Context

Leaf of `#21140` (`The examples section becomes Neo's kitchen sink`, cornerstone 1 of Engine 14 in `ROADMAP.md`, cut Mon 23 Nov). Implements `#21140` Design 8 (`A find field`) in one PR stacked cleanly on the `Shell` leaf PR.

## The Problem

Even with the 21-group list (`GroupIndex`) docked beside `/examples` and every group page, visitors have no cross-cutting search across ~140 Kitchen Sink entries. A visitor looking for *"drag"* across the platform (matching `Sprint Board` whose home group caption or `alsoIn: ['drag-drop']` establishes drag support without `"drag"` in its title) or *"date"* across `Calendar`, `Scheduler`, `Gantt`, and `Forms & Fields` has to open group pages one by one and scroll. Cold readers specifically requested a find/filter field across all entries.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Shell` hoists `.portal-examples-sidebar` (`apps/portal/view/examples/MainContainer.mjs`) above/beside `.portal-examples-stage` (`card` layout), leaving a top slot at the head of `.portal-examples-sidebar` above `GroupIndex` (`presentation: 'list'`), plus the shared mobile `GroupIndex` (`presentation: 'sheet'`) and mobile `Overview` index.
- `Portal.view.examples.MainContainer#getCatalogStore()` holds every `Portal.model.Example` record in memory (`catalog`), and `MainContainer#getGroupStore()` / `familyDefinitions` holds the 21 group definitions and titles (`family -> title`).
- `apps/portal/model/Example.mjs`: defines catalog fields (`name`, `feature`, `lookFor`, `component`, `family`, `alsoIn`), currently without an optional `keywords` array field.
- Design authority: `#21140` body Design 8 and cold-reader note (`"a filter over all entries: design 8, the Find lane, in Engine 14's scope"`), plus Clio's field-list rule (`#21140#issuecomment-6980120568`: searches entry `name`, `feature`, `lookFor`, `component`, home + `alsoIn` group titles, and optional `keywords`).

## The Fix

1. **Add optional `keywords` field on `Portal.model.Example`:** `{name: 'keywords', type: 'Array', defaultValue: []}` and define matching fields on existing catalog rows where titles/captions alone would miss high-value visitor terms (without breaking existing schema tests).
2. **Mount one synchronized Find input across desktop sidebar (`MainContainer`) and mobile (`sheet` + mobile `Overview` index):**
   - Place a clearable `Neo.form.field.Search` (or `Text` search field with `'/'` shortcut badge and `Escape` clear) at the head of `.portal-examples-sidebar` and reflect/bind the shared `findQuery` state in the phone `sheet` and entry page so desktop and phone stay synchronized via `MainContainer`'s state provider.
3. **Filter live as the visitor types:**
   - Match published records (`Example.publishes(record, catalogMode)`) case-insensitively across `name`, `feature`, `lookFor`, `component`, the group title of `family`, every group title of `alsoIn`, and `keywords`.
   - Switch `.portal-examples-stage` to a dedicated search-results view showing matching entries grouped under their home group heading (rendering cards/tiles cleanly); while active, `GroupIndex` displays per-group match counts and dims zero-match groups (`opacity` / muted styling + `aria-disabled` or muted indicator as appropriate while keeping `"All examples"` / clearing accessible).
   - Clearing the query (clicking clear, deleting input, or pressing `Escape`) restores the previously open route page (`Overview` or active `GroupPage`) and returns focus from the field when cleared via `Escape`; `'/'` outside inputs focuses the find field; typing never pushes browser URL hash history entries.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: A find field renders at the head of `.portal-examples-sidebar` on desktop and on phone (entry page + sheet), filtering published entries live as the visitor types over `name`, `feature`, `lookFor`, `component`, home + `alsoIn` group titles, and optional `keywords`.
- [ ] AC-2: Non-empty queries show matches grouped under their group name in the stage, show per-group match counts in `GroupIndex`, dim 0-match groups, and keep the URL hash unchanged (no history entries written while typing).
- [ ] AC-3: `"drag"` finds `Sprint Board` (via group/cross-list title / `alsoIn` / `keywords`) alongside drag examples; `"date"` finds date/calendar/scheduler/Gantt examples across groups.
- [ ] AC-4: `'/'` focuses the find field; `Escape` or clearing restores the previously open page and returns focus cleanly.
- [ ] AC-5: Unit specs (`MainContainerController.spec.mjs`), `seo/verify.mjs`, and Whitebox E2E (`ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs`) pass.
- [ ] AC-6: **Look:** before and after frames at `1440×900` and `390×844` for queries `"drag"` and `"date"`, read cold with `after > before` `[L3-deferred — operator handoff needed: sessionless subagent cold-reader spawn blocked under GEMINI.md Arm A1 zero-subagent baseline on neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1853; whole-surface pairs embedded for cross-family reviewer + #21140 cold read]`.

## Out of Scope

- Putting the search query in the URL hash or SSR crawler routes (explicitly post-step in `#21140` Design 8).
- Modifying `GroupIndex` membership or group card/tile rendering beyond grouped search results (handled by `Shell` and `Tiles`).

## Avoided Traps

- Matching only `name` and `feature` (misses `"drag"` on `Sprint Board` and cross-listed groups).
- Mutating `document.location.hash` on keystroke (breaks browser Back/Forward).
- Hardcoding group titles instead of reading `MainContainer#familyDefinitions`.
